# Recello

> Recello (recello.in) is a Pune-based startup that buys used phones and tablets. Customers get an instant price online, book a free doorstep pickup and are paid in cash or by UPI before the agent leaves. Laptops are coming soon.

Recello was founded by Kabier Ranveersingh Thakur, Santosh Pandit Aiwale and Mohan Shankar Rathod, who spent more than nine years as vendors in Pune's phone market. It also offers doorstep phone repair, a free phone test in the browser and free recycling.

## How selling works

1. Search for the phone or tablet and pick its RAM and storage.
2. Answer a few questions about its condition.
3. Verify a mobile number with a one-time code to see the price. The price is held for 7 days.
4. Book a free 2-hour pickup slot. The agent checks the device at the door and pays in cash or by UPI before leaving.
